baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperatives كُلُوا and تَمَتَّعُوا are restricted by قَلِيلًا, and the following إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ identifies the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food intake and enjoyed benefit form a temporary license; fewness narrows its amount, degree, or duration, while the offense branch makes criminal identity the reason the license cannot be open-ended.

activation_trace.role: Literal food ingestion supplies the first permitted activity and the concrete appetite around which the sentence is organized.
Enjoyed use or benefit broadens eating into a general interval of taking advantage.
Fewness and smallness place a hard bound on the licensed consumption and benefit.
Guilt and offense identify the users of the license and make its restriction punitive rather than ascetic.

changed_reading.before: Eat and enjoy a little because you are criminals.
changed_reading.after: Consume and take benefit, but only inside a sharply bounded allowance whose limit follows from your status as offenders.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus words can present consumption as taking an allotment and مُجْرِمُونَ as agents who earn or cause an incurred consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A consumable share and usable goods are briefly taken into possession; the earning/incurring branch of ج ر م turns that benefit into an account in which present acquisition also accrues liability.

activation_trace.role: A consumable share or provision recasts eating as drawing down an allotment.
Usable goods and provision make enjoyment the use of an account of available means.
Smallness limits the available share rather than merely lowering emotional pleasure.
Earning, acquiring, or causing to incur supplies the counter-entry: benefit taken now is consequence accrued.

changed_reading.before: The addressees receive a short spell of pleasure before punishment.
changed_reading.after: They draw down a small consumable allotment while simultaneously acquiring the liability named by مُجْرِمُونَ.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَمَتَّعُوا can activate going off with something, قَلِيلًا can activate lifting or departing with a load, and مُجْرِمُونَ retains a cutting-off image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated commands can be heard as dismissal with provisions: take a consumable share, go off with only a light load, and do so as a class being cut away from what held it.

activation_trace.role: Consumable provision supplies the small stock carried into departure.
Going off with a thing or dispensing with someone turns enjoyment into a possible dismissal movement.
Carrying, lifting, and departing gives قَلِيلًا a form-distant image of a light outbound load.
Cutting off supplies the social and spatial separation imposed on the departing offenders.

changed_reading.after: Take a little usable provision and go; the address dismisses a class already being cut off.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah turns an announced event into an appointed and bounded Day of Separation, then shows destruction passing from former peoples to later offenders. Against that clock, the focus branch for prolonged benefit is curtailed by قَلِيلًا, while the completed-and-cut-off-time branch of ج ر م makes the offenders' interval one already approaching closure.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged keeping for benefit exposes duration as a live dimension of تَمَتَّعُوا for the context to bound.
Fewness converts the surrounding schedule into a short remaining interval.
Completed and cut-off time lets the offender label resonate with an interval reaching its severed end.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the promised event a scheduled horizon.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the schedule into an event that will actually land.
Delimitation by a time or endpoint explicitly supplies temporal bounding.
A duration of time provides the unit within which delay and termination are staged.
A fixed temporal endpoint supplies the terminus of the apparent respite.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood explains what the endpoint does.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized result of an expired interval.
Succession makes the same terminal process pass from earlier to later groups.
The repeated offender label directly joins the focus addressees to the group on whom the terminal process acts.

structural_cues: 77:7-18 advances from promised occurrence through timing, fixed term, the Day of Separation, and the destruction of successive offenders.
The focus command arrives near the close after the surah has repeatedly returned to that scheduled day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promised event, explicit timing and term, separation, succession, and an earlier use of the offender label; I infer that this clock selects short duration as the leading force of قَلِيلًا and makes the focus license a respite expiring at judgment. A small quantity of food remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: قَلِيلًا may restrict either how much is consumed or how long enjoyment lasts.
changed_reading.after: The whole-surah schedule makes remaining duration dominant: enjoy only until the already appointed separation reaches this later class of offenders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places human material in a stable repository, makes earth a container for living and dead, releases the deniers toward their destination, and gathers all groups for separation. This containment-release-regathering sequence activates the focus's distant departure branches: the offenders are dismissed with only a small usable provision before being gathered.

activation_trace.role: Consumable provision supplies what can be taken through the movement sequence.
Going off with something or dispensing with someone supplies the focus's dismissal motion.
Carrying, lifting, and departing images the little provision as a light outbound load.
Cutting off supplies the separation imposed on the class being sent away.
Fixity and settlement establish the first secure containment state.
Gathering and holding in a vessel turns earth into a second encompassing container.
Unimpeded departure reverses containment and sends the addressees toward a destination.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the terminal regathering after release.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 moves from a secure reproductive repository to earth as the holder of living and dead.
77:29 commands departure, while 77:38 announces regathering for the Day of Separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable containment, an encompassing vessel, commanded departure, and regathering; I infer a directional cycle and map the focus's going-off and carrying branches onto it, so the command can sound like dismissal with a light provision. The ordinary sense 'enjoy briefly' remains more form-near.

changed_reading.before: The offenders merely enjoy for a little while in place.
changed_reading.after: The line can also dismiss them from containment: take a little provision and depart as a cut-off group moving toward regathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to depart leads to a shade that provides no protection from flame and to fire throwing sparks. The focus branch in which eating means feeding a blaze permits a reversal: the present consumers' interval of enjoyment is also an interval in which they feed the fire that will turn them from eaters into what is consumed.

activation_trace.role: Fire consuming fuel and being fed supplies the eater-to-fuel reversal anchored in كُلُوا.
Enjoyed use supplies the present interval whose apparent benefit conceals its role as fuel.
Departure without restraint starts the compelled movement toward the fiery destination.
Shelter and protection are invoked only to be negated in the next ayah, exposing the travelers to flame.
The tongue and ignition of fire provide the consuming agent toward which the movement runs.
Sending or throwing gives the blaze outward agency rather than making it a static backdrop.
Flying sparks materialize the blaze's active consumption and spread.

structural_cues: 77:29-32 is a command-led path from departure to false shelter, flame, and thrown sparks.
The focus later repeats an imperative of intake, allowing the earlier fire scene to reverse who consumes whom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a branch where fire eats fuel and a contextual path into active flame; I infer the directional reversal that present consumption feeds a future consumer and makes the eater potential fuel. The materially live alternative is simple juxtaposition: worldly eating now, fire later, without a causal feeding relation.

changed_reading.before: They are the agents who consume during a brief respite.
changed_reading.after: Their consuming can be heard as feeding the blaze that will reverse agency and consume them; enjoyment is a fuel interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact eating imperative first belongs to a scene of drinking without harm, grounded in purposeful deeds and recompense for good-doers. Three ayat later, the focus keeps eating but removes drink, ease, and deed-based reward, replacing them with little benefit and offender identity. The second command is therefore a punitive counter-banquet, not a neutral permission.

activation_trace.role: Literal eating is the repeated verbal hinge between the two opposed meals.
Enjoyed benefit is the focus's reduced substitute for the earlier meal's explicit ease.
Fewness marks the decisive contraction from the rewarded meal to the offenders' allowance.
Offense supplies the adverse identity that replaces the earlier good-doer identity.
The same food-ingestion imperative establishes deliberate lexical mirroring.
Taking liquid completes the earlier meal and highlights what the focus command omits.
Ease without hardship or harmful aftereffect gives the rewarded meal its untroubled quality.
Purposeful action supplies the stated basis for the earlier meal.
Answering an act with its recompense identifies the earlier meal as settlement rather than mere indulgence.
Doing what is good names the favorable class opposed to the focus's offenders.

structural_cues: 77:43 and 77:46 begin with the identical plural imperative كُلُوا.
77:43-44 grounds an easy meal in deeds and recompense for good-doers; after the refrain at 77:45, 77:46 grounds little enjoyment in offender identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact imperative repetition, opposed predicates, and two distinct grounds for the meals; I infer deliberate rhetorical mirroring and read the second command with ironic punitive force. The live alternative is that both commands are literal but independently situated, without a designed counter-banquet relation.

changed_reading.before: The focus grants a generic, short-lived worldly pleasure.
changed_reading.after: It stages an anti-reward: the offenders hear the same 'eat' given to good-doers, but stripped of drink, ease, durable recompense, and honorable identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated denial-root refrain immediately encloses the focus. Its branch images of milk failing to continue and an animal's run stopping oppose the focus branch of prolonged benefit; قَلِيلًا then describes enjoyment as structurally unable to persist, not only externally rationed.

activation_trace.role: Continued preservation for benefit supplies the continuity that the surrounding denial branches interrupt.
Fewness names the short result of that failed continuity.
Milk that disappears and does not last supplies a material image of benefit drying up before the focus.
A run that begins and then stops supplies a motion image of curtailed continuation after the focus.

structural_cues: The identical refrain at 77:45 and 77:47 brackets 77:46 on both sides.
The enclosing root's two non-continuance images converge on the focus pair تَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formal enclosure, a continued-benefit branch, and denial branches of drying up and stopped motion; I infer that the enclosure maps non-continuance onto the offenders' enjoyment. The live alternative is that the refrain only labels rejection and that قَلِيلًا alone supplies brevity.

changed_reading.before: Enjoyment is brief because an external deadline cuts it short.
changed_reading.after: The bracket of denial also makes enjoyment non-durable in kind: it dries up or stops rather than reaching sustained benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: On the Day of Separation the accused neither speak nor receive permission to excuse themselves, and their remaining strategy is challenged as futile. This legal-discursive closure sharpens إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ into an operative classification: the imperatives are a sentence addressed to them, while the following nominal clause leaves no defense slot.

activation_trace.role: Guilt and offense make مُجْرِمُونَ the charge-like classification at the center of the speech closure.
Voice resonance from the body makes the context's removal of speech an especially pointed secondary activation of the same focus root.
Speech is explicitly named as the capacity unavailable on that day.
Permission or authorization supplies the denied procedural opening to respond.
Excuse and exculpation identify the defense that cannot be offered.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood provides the forum in which the classification becomes final.
Scheme and stratagem supply the only imagined counter-move, which the challenge exposes as unavailable.

structural_cues: 77:35-39 moves from no speech and no authorized excuse to gathering, judgment, and a challenge to produce any effective plan.
The focus itself gives the addressees two imperatives followed by an emphatic nominal classification, with no reply represented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech prohibition, denied authorization to excuse, separating judgment, and a futile-strategy challenge; I infer that إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ functions pragmatically as a verdict and that the imperatives are part of sentencing discourse. It may alternatively remain an explanatory rebuke before that later speechless day.

changed_reading.before: 'You are criminals' merely explains why their enjoyment is short.
changed_reading.after: The clause also sounds like a final classification delivered in a discourse where the classified party has no authorized defense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it routes مُجْرِمُونَ through cutting and harvest residue rather than its offense branch, and it uses the non-dominant harvest target supplied for context ج ز ي. It remains anchored in the focus's ج ر م and eating/yield branches and is reinforced by contextual fruit and harvest-time images. Downstream prose should present it only as a harvest overlay, never as a replacement lexical gloss for 'criminals.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كُلُوا can activate fruit or yield, while مُجْرِمُونَ can activate both severing a crop and the residue left after harvest.

activation_trace.role: Fruit or crop yield turns the object of eating into harvest produce.
Cutting and harvesting make the offender label resonate with severance at harvest.
Fallen residue and dried date matter supply the post-harvest state into which the addressees can be imaged.
Pleasant fruit makes actual produce visible immediately before the paired eating commands.
The non-dominant mapped branch of ripeness and harvest time lets recompense coincide with a cutting threshold.

changed_reading.before: Offenders consume a small amount before judgment.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory harvest register, they consume yield at the very threshold where they themselves become the severed crop or its residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a mountain-height branch into pride and a bodily-mass branch of ج ر م into ethical posture. It remains anchored in the focus's bodily eater and مُجْرِمُونَ and in the explicit later refusal to bend. Downstream prose should qualify it as an embodied spatial analogy, not as morphology or a direct paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins bodily intake to a ج ر م branch of shaped bodily mass; the context supplies raised posture and refused lowering.

activation_trace.role: Ingestion foregrounds the body as receptive to appetite.
Bodily bulk and shaped mass make offender identity spatially embodied.
Raising the nose in pride supplies the elevated ethical posture latent in the mountain adjective.
Humility and self-lowering are explicitly refused, completing the posture contrast.

changed_reading.before: The line condemns appetite in general terms.
changed_reading.after: It can image an appetite-organized body that opens itself to intake while keeping itself proudly unbent when called to lower itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's non-dominant ك ل ل target is form-distant from the actual ء ك ل imperative. It remains packet-authorized and focus-anchored, while the plural command and contextual gathering make collective scope visible. Downstream prose should render it only as a totality resonance, not as an alternative derivation of كُلُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ء ك ل secondarily to a branch of totality and completeness, and the imperative itself addresses a plural class.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness supply an exhaustive scope resonance around the plural eating command.
Completion without dispersion turns gathering into inclusion of the whole addressed class.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified group is told to eat briefly.
changed_reading.after: The command and verdict can carry exhaustive class scope: all of the gathered offenders are included in the same bounded allowance.

strongest_changes: The exact كُلُوا echo in 77:43 and 77:46 recasts the focus as a punitive counter-banquet opposed to recompense for good-doers.
The promised, timed, fixed, and separating day makes قَلِيلًا primarily a short remaining duration rather than merely a small portion.
The speechless judgment sequence sharpens إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ from explanation into an operative verdict without an authorized reply.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made lexical repetition and sequence do more work than local topic: a rewarded meal mirrors the focus meal, a long timing chain closes its duration, and unusual branches expose dismissal, failed continuity, fire reversal, harvest, bodily posture, and collective scope without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: قَلِيلًا can still limit quantity, degree, or duration; context privileges duration but does not erase the other scopes.
The dismissal, fire, harvest, bodily-posture, and totality readings rely on branch-level resonance and should remain exploratory rather than lexical replacements.
إِنَّكُم may function causally, descriptively, or verdictively, and the packet supports coexistence more clearly than disambiguation.
